title: H-LONG2 (asymmetric thr_long) REJECTED — no cell meets pre-registered bars; mechanism found: thin longs gate-keep worse late-day trades (path-dependence)
summary: thr_long in {0.50,0.55,0.60} scanned (seed 0) then T=0.55 confirmed over 4 streams. Family-wise success bar (loss<300 & DD>=25%) FAILS (loss $1,021); partial bar (Sharpe>B 1.59) FAILS (1.17). T=0.55 mean +$3,466/-1,276DD vs A +$4,487/-1,820 — strictly dominated by short-only B. Key finding: cutting the (0.45,0.5] long band (own PnL only +$220) costs ~$947 because the first-cross rule is path-dependent — thin early longs screen out worse later entries. Side-conditioned negative cells located: short (0.55,0.60] -11.7/tr, long (0.6,1.0] -21.7/tr -> H-PROB refined to side-conditioned band gates next cycle. No algo code changed.

title: H-LONG falsified: dropping longs costs ~$1,134 mean PnL but halves maxDD (-45%) and lifts Sharpe +34% — longs are thin-paid, not noise
summary: Short-only E3 variant tested across 4 walk-forward streams (cached signals, identical exits). Pre-registered prediction (PnL holds within +/-300) FAILS: B mean +$3,353 vs A +$4,487 — longs contribute real thin edge (~+$4/trade, positive in all 4 streams). But B dominates risk-adjusted in every stream: Sharpe 1.19->1.59, maxDD -1,821->-995, worst-q -378->-195, PF 1.21->1.36. C (short re-entry) rejected: -470 vs B. Decision: no live change (absolute PnL is the registry currency); queue H-LONG2 asymmetric thresholds (thr_long 0.50-0.55). No algo code changed (measurement only).
